# scaling_oncall_schedule (Data Source)

Looks up an on-call schedule by name and exposes its id, so an escalation step can target a schedule created out-of-band without hardcoding the generated id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reference an on-call schedule created out-of-band by name, for use as an
# escalation step's target_id.
data "scaling_oncall_schedule" "primary" {
  name = "Primary On-Call"
}

output "primary_schedule_id" {
  value = data.scaling_oncall_schedule.primary.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the on-call schedule to look up. Must be unique within the organization.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description, or null if unset.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the matched on-call schedule.
- `org_id` (String) Organization that owns the schedule.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone the schedule's rotations are anchored to.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 last-update timestamp.
